column1: # The JEI API each carrier version's JeiRecipeProbe compiles against (compile-only, never bundled):
# minecraft<TAB>version. Measured 2026-10-24 from that maven's maven-metadata.xml (newest per line; 1.21.1 keeps the
# smoke harness's own pin). A Minecraft version with no row has no JEI build (1.21.2 and 1.21.3 have none): its carrier
# gets the stand-in probe (JeiRecipeProbe.nojei.java), which behaves as JEI-absent does everywhere else.
